# @mission-platform/vcard

Shared vCard contact payload builder and typed options for Mission Platform

## Installation

Add it to a consuming workspace member:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@mission-platform/vcard": "workspace:*"
  }
}
```

## Usage

```ts
import { vCard, type VCardOptions } from '@mission-platform/vcard';

const contact: VCardOptions = { firstName: 'Ada', lastName: 'Lovelace' };
const payload = vCard(contact);
```
